mapper.sql: select id, benefit_text, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_vip_benefit
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0'
and benefit_text like concat('%', #{benefitText}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by sort_order asc, id asc
where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into wl_vip_benefit(benefit_text, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark) values(#{benefitText}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wl_vip_benefit set benefit_text = #{benefitText}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update wl_vip_benefit set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
